insights.summary: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue was ₹180 Cr (+36% per management; regulated markets +42%, emerging markets +30%) with EBITDA ₹54 Cr (about 30%) and PAT ₹31 Cr (+56%). Management kept FY27 guidance of 30-40% revenue and 50-60% PAT growth, and talked of ₹2,500-3,000 Cr revenue in 3-4 years. Sequentially profits dipped because Q4 had ₹14-15 Cr of forex gains, and emerging-market margin fell to 14% from 20%.

what_changed.text: FY27 capex cut to ₹100-120 Cr from about ₹200 Cr; sterile injectables scaled down to a pilot, IPO money moved to oral solids
India branded generics target cut to ₹50-60 Cr from ₹60-70 Cr, with focus on profitability
PIC/S approval now Q2-Q3 instead of June-July
Approved ANDAs up to 58 (23 launched); 39 molecules in development

tone.label: steady
tone.quote: I think I will stick to our guidance what we have given for the full year

analyst_questions.answer: H1 is seasonally weak; full-year 18-20% EBITDA margin still expected.
Q4 FY26 had ₹14-15 Cr of forex gains; Q1 had almost none. Other income is now presented differently.
Money moved from a new sterile plant to oral-solid capacity in the US and India; injectables start as a smaller pilot. Needs shareholder approval.
Waiting for the India-US trade deal; having plants in both countries makes them neutral.

red_flags.text: Sequential decline in EBITDA and PAT once Q4's forex gains drop out.
India branded generics fell 2% YoY and the FY27 target was cut.
IPO proceeds being redirected from the stated sterile injectables project.
Management misstated regulated-market growth on the call (said 36%, corrected to 42%).

watch_next: Emerging-market margin recovering towards 18-20% in H2
Launches from the 35 approved but unlaunched ANDAs
Zoraya and Amerisyn starting sales in September-October
Shareholder vote on the change in IPO fund use

business_snapshot.what_they_make: US and regulated-market generics (own ANDAs and CDMO-CMO), emerging-market exports, India branded generics; plants in Atlanta (US), Chhatral and Baroda (Apnar)
business_snapshot.customers: US partners who sell under their own label, own front end (Zoraya), US government via Amerisyn, CDMO clients, emerging-market distributors
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: About 70% regulated and 30% emerging markets; India branded generics about ₹8 Cr a quarter
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Launch of approved ANDAs, CGT and first-to-market products, 900+ emerging-market registrations pending
